title: Integrated Single-Cell and Bulk RNA-Sequencing Analysis Identifies an Aging-Related Gene Signature for Prognosis in Breast Cancer.
snippet: Cellular senescence exerts a complex influence on BRCA progression and TME remodeling. However, the specific roles of ASIGs in regulating the TME and determining patient outcomes remain unclear. Using TCGA (training), METABRIC (validation), and single-cell RNA-seq datasets, we systematically characterized ASIGs in BRCA. Prognostic ASIGs were identified to d...
